description: This file defines UI components for a navigation menu using React and Radix UI primitives, including container components, trigger, content, link, indicator, viewport, and related styles.

methods.name: NavigationMenu
methods.description: Main container component for the navigation menu, rendering a Radix UI NavigationMenu Primitive Root with optional viewport.

methods.name: NavigationMenuList
methods.description: Wrapper for the list of menu items, using Radix UI List primitive.

methods.name: NavigationMenuItem
methods.description: Component for individual menu items, wrapping Radix UI Item primitive.

methods.name: NavigationMenuTrigger
methods.description: Clickable trigger component for opening submenus, styled with cva and including an icon.

methods.name: NavigationMenuContent
methods.description: Component representing the dropdown content of the menu, with animation and styling.

methods.name: NavigationMenuViewport
methods.description: Container for the viewport of dropdowns, managing positioning and animation.

methods.name: NavigationMenuLink
methods.description: Link component within the menu, styled to indicate active or focus state.

methods.name: NavigationMenuIndicator
methods.description: Visual indicator component that shows active/focus state, including a small rotated square div.
